description:
Re-scoped after the Family-B investigation (see this ticket's comment for the full 3-mechanism breakdown). SHAPE-LAYER, the only clean Family-B-scope fix. ONLY covers #2 compiler2_native_program_does_not_fabricate_nil_for_zero_width_resume_payloads. #1/#3/#4 moved to demand-layer ticket fz-go4.18.3.2.3.

PROBLEM
The landed keystone (fz-go4.18.3.1) gates producer-sourcing on !demand.is_callable(), which OVER-REACHES onto fully-ignored by-value (non-destination-passing) returns: the genuinely-discarded Enum.each element-call resume (is_ignore demand, single-Function callee) gets producer-sourced to Lane(13), ERASING the zero-width continuation #2 requires.

FIX (correct-by-construction)
Distinguish DESTINATION-PASSING returns (callee writes fields into the caller frame, e.g. ExecutableNeed::TupleFields -- must keep its slots even when a field is ignored) from BY-VALUE returns (returned by value, can be discarded -> stays zero-width/Nothing when ignored). Producer-source the former; retain zero-width for an ignored by-value return. (Proven proxy: experimental gate !demand.is_callable() && !demand.is_ignore() greens #2 with no observed effect on the keystone's 2 greens or on #1/#3 -- implement the principled destination-passing-vs-by-value version, not the bare is_ignore proxy.)

SIGNAL
#2 green; keystone greens (jit_runs_enum_map_reduce, matches_tuple_field_call_continuations) STAY green; no new failures. Expected 932 passed / 5 failed (remaining 5 = Family A #2tests + demand cluster #1/#3/#4), STABLE across >=3 fresh full runs. Schedule-independence guard for zero-width retention. No test weakening; no legacy revival.

comments.text:
FAMILY-B DIAGNOSIS WAS WRONG (investigated, no commit; instrumented position_shapes + the resume gate in project_one_executable + the ExecutableReturn anchor; ran one reverted gate experiment). The 4 "Family B" tests span THREE distinct mechanisms pulling in OPPOSITE directions, most in the DEMAND layer (out of shape-only scope):

#1 jit_adapts_callable_raw_returns_back_to_value_refs -- genuine Nothing-collapse. Resume is reducer.(head, acc) (callable dispatch, opaque param) inside reduce_plain. callsite_callee_return_position returns None (no single SelectedCallee::Function) -> keystone producer_return is None -> falls to demand-driven resume_shape -> resume value's demand is is_ignore -> Shape(Nothing) -> native fatals materializing delivered Ty(21). But the result IS consumed (becomes recursive acc), so demand is UNDER-reported. No producer ExecutableReturn position exists for an opaque callable. Fix needs a callable-dispatch producer source (callable's boxed-ValueRef return ABI) OR demand correction -- NOT the keystone shape_graph.equal move. DEMAND/CALLABLE layer.

#2 does_not_fabricate_nil_for_zero_width_resume_payloads -- OPPOSITE of the diagnosis, and the LANDED KEYSTONE GATE is the cause. The genuinely-discarded Enum.each element-call resume (is_ignore demand, single-Function callee) is producer-sourced by the keystone's !demand.is_callable() to Lane(13), ERASING the zero-width continuation the test requires. Experimental gate !demand.is_callable() && !demand.is_ignore() makes #2 PASS with no observed effect on #1/#3. So the keystone's !demand.is_callable() OVER-REACHES onto fully-ignored by-value (non-destination-passing) returns. Correct-by-construction fix = the DESTINATION-PASSING-vs-BY-VALUE distinction: destination-passing (TupleFields, writes into caller frame) keeps its slots even when a field is ignored; a by-value discarded return stays zero-width. This is a REFINEMENT/redesign of the keystone gate (shape layer), tractable and landable. SHAPE layer.

#3 resource_fixture_shapes_callable_boundaries_explicitly -- NOT resume-shape. fz_make_resource/2's ExecutableReturn is anchored (transport.rs:1845) from its OWN settled runtime_demand.return_demand = Whole, so return_reprs is non-empty even though main discards the handle. With the resume equal removed (experiment) it STILL fails -> over-transport is the callee's semantic return_demand=Whole, independent of the keystone. call_return_demand_contributions already drops is_ignore observed returns (runtime_demand.rs:689), so the spurious Whole enters via the callable/typed-boundary return-demand path for this signature-typed boundary. DEMAND layer.

#4 escaping_destructor_keys_its_activation_at_the_grounded_boundary_surface -- shares fixture 00026_make_resource.fz with #3, schedule-dependent (full-run-only PoisonError), asserts boundary-surface activation keying. Entangled with the same typed-boundary return-demand/keying machinery as #3. DEMAND/keying layer (consistent with a monotonicity root, not a shape Nothing).

RULED OUT: keystone did not modify these test bodies; call_return_demand_contributions already skips ignored returns; keystone data-return resume shape is not the lever for #1/#3/#4.

RE-DECOMPOSITION:
- .18.3.2.2 (re-scoped) = SHAPE layer: refine the keystone resume gate to destination-passing-vs-by-value (greens #2). Proven: experimental !is_ignore greens #2, no effect on #1/#3.
- NEW demand/identity-layer ticket = #1 (callable-dispatch consumed-result under-demand) + #3/#4 (typed-boundary return_demand raised to Whole when all call sites discard + schedule-dependent keying). This overlaps Family A (.18.3.2.1) identity/round-trip and the parent's demand-monotonicity locus; likely a shared core demand/identity convergence root. Coordinate with the Family A spike result before implementing.

CRITICAL FINDING (fz-go4.18.3.2.2 investigation, no commit, 3-fresh-run verified): the prescribed shape-layer-only fix for #2 is NON-VIABLE, and the premise it rested on was a FALSE-GREEN.

FALSE-GREEN CAUGHT
The earlier Family-B investigation's sanity check -- "experimental gate !demand.is_callable() && !demand.is_ignore() greens #2 with no effect on the keystone greens or the other residuals" -- was a SCHEDULE-LUCKY SINGLE RUN. Re-run 3x fresh, that gate STABLY regresses 10 tests: mine 923 passed/15 failed (3 runs identical: 178s/228s/166s) vs base 05d67704 931/6 (3 runs identical: 199s/242s/173s). Set diff exact: base - {does_not_fabricate_nil} + {10 new}. The 10 new are GENUINE fatals (not poison cascades), e.g. jit_keeps_tail_recursion_bounded: "native attempted to materialize absent value as runtime value with ty Some(Ty(21)) in Continuation" -- the EXACT class the keystone fixed by producer-sourcing. The 10: cont_threaded_recursion, interp_runs_{enum_with_index, range_and_map_to_list, range_reduce_scalar_bridge}, native_codegen_keeps_callable_boundary...range_reduce_bridge, jit_keeps_tail_recursion_bounded, jit_runs_nontail_if_join..., keeps_distinct_direct_callable_executables..., routes_nontail_if_join..., transport_plan_does_not_publish_dead_callable_input_boundaries.

ROOT CAUSE (the ticket premise is false)
is_ignore CANNOT separate "genuinely-discarded by-value" (Enum.each -> must retain zero-width, #2) from "consumed-but-under-demanded by-value" (tail-recursion accumulator, range/map intermediates -> must be producer-sourced). is_ignore UNDER-REPORTS for the consumed case -- the SAME under-reported-demand defect (#1) assigned to fz-go4.18.3.2.3. So narrowing the keystone's broad !is_callable gate by is_ignore breaks the consumed cases.
=> The landed keystone gate (!demand.is_callable()) is CORRECT (it producer-sources consumed-but-under-demanded returns, which tail recursion etc. need). #2 (zero-width retention) is in genuine TENSION with it, resolvable ONLY with a reliable CONSUMPTION signal (actual resume-value use-edges in the lowered body), which lives in the demand layer. Destination-passing-ness IS reliably ABI-derivable (ExecutableNeed::TupleFields) and that half is correct; the discard-vs-consume by-value half is NOT available at the shape layer.

CONCLUSION
#2 is entangled with #1; cannot be greened in shape-layer isolation. Fold #2 into the demand-layer fix (fz-go4.18.3.2.3) so the gate keys off a RELIABLE consumption signal (resume-value use-edges) instead of is_ignore. Keystone stays as-is. The TDD guard the agent wrote (compiler2_native_program_resume_shape_distinguishes_destination_passing_from_ignored_by_value: quicksort extra_params==2 destination-passing AND Enum.each extra_params==0 genuinely-zero-width) is correct and reusable once a reliable signal exists -- land it with .2.3.

PROCESS LESSON: every "greens X with no regressions" claim in this cluster must be 3x-fresh-run verified. Single-run greens are not evidence here.

title: Land destination-passing-vs-discard resume guard + #2 zero-width retention (after .2.3 provides a reliable consumption signal)
